owns: surface entry records for descriptor consumers

dispatch_shape.name: any slot address
dispatch_shape.input: opaque payload the row itself carries

payload.name: timed-action-write-scheduled-action
payload.description: Write generic scheduled-action graph records and receipts.

payload.name: timed-action-run-recurring-owner-v1
payload.description: Run one DATA-selected synchronous owner action, then atomically prove both the recurring occurrence and the scheduled-action receipt. A failed owner call writes neither proof, so the exact same occurrence remains eligible for retry.

payload.name: timed-action-materialize-recurring-windows-v1
payload.description: Read generic recurring schedule/state DATA, compute the first unresolved occurrence per schedule, and persist deterministic scheduled-action graph rows before due evaluation.

payload.name: timed-action-on-clock-tick-v1
payload.description: Materialize unresolved recurring windows first, then evaluate all due scheduled actions in the same clock-tick workflow.

payload.name: timed-action-evaluate-due-scheduled-actions-v3
payload.description: Tick evaluator (row-carried dispatch): query the scheduled-action graph (records/time-windows/actions/receipts), compute due-and-unfired fires via the mounted CLI, and loop the blind per-item fire definition. Fully generic - the evaluator never learns owner invocation shapes; each scheduled-action-action row carries its OWN dispatch config as DATA.

payload.name: timed-action-fire-scheduled-action-v3
payload.description: One due fire, fully data-driven: re-read the scheduled-action-action row for this record, then follow the dispatch config THE ROW ITSELF carries. A slot::workflow execute_definition request runs in this already-open workflow process; every other slot address uses the ordinary address-envelope ask. The def then stamps an idempotency receipt keyed (record_id, operation). It never enumerates methods or targets; a retracted or dispatch-less row fails closed (no dispatch, no receipt).

payload.name: timed-action-materialize-scheduled-action-view
payload.description: Fold the live scheduled-action graph into the UI projection shape `{projection_id, items, groups, proof}` using the package-owned graph reader.

payload.name: timed-action-materialize-and-write-scheduled-action-view
payload.description: Run the scheduled-action view materializer and write the folded projection to the caller-supplied or default timed-action projection address.
